description: This file provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments related to Vitest test reports, loading Vitest JSON reports, and formatting milliseconds values.

methods.name: parseVitestReportArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for Vitest report options, applying default values and recognizing specific flags.
parameters: defaults: object with default config, limit, reportPath

methods.name: loadVitestReportFromArgs
methods.description: Loads the Vitest JSON report based on parsed arguments and a given prefix.

methods.name: formatMs
methods.description: Formats a millisecond value to a string with one decimal place followed by 'ms'.
parameters: digits: number of decimal digits to include
